unparsed_top: Place the bread and cheese on the cutting board.
Take the two sugar cubes and place them on the plate with the cake.
Pick up the butter stick and place it in the pan. Then turn on the burner for the pan.
pick up the sugar cube(s) and place them in the saucepan with hot chocolate.
Place the sponge inside the microwave to prepare for sanitizing.
Take the chicken drumsticks from the pan and place one on each plate on the dining counter.
The ice cube tray has been filled with water. Take the tray and place it in the freezer to make ice. Close the freezer door after placing the tray.
There is a wine glass and glass cup on the dining counter. Place the wine bottle next to the wine glass and the juice bottle next to the glass cup.
Retrieve the frozen meat and place it in the pot on a burner. Then turn the burner on.
Pick the mug and place it in the sink. Pick the bowl and place it in the open cabinet and then close the cabinet.
Place the avocado, onion, tomato, and bell pepper on the cutting board.
Place the drinks on the dining counter in a tight cluster.
Wait until the marinara sauce is simmered to a deep red color and then turn off the stove.
Pick up the marshmallow and place it in the cup of hot chocolate on the dining counter.
Clear the non-vegetable object off the cutting board and place the vegetables onto it.
Clear the mugs and bowl far away from the sink.
Pick the egg and butter from the fridge and place them by the bowl for mixing.
Pick and place the pan from the current burner to another burner and turn the burner on.
Take the cinnamon bottle from the cabinet and place it on the dining table, next to the plate with the cupcake. Then take the chocolate from the dining counter and place it on the cupcake plate.
Place the microwavable item in the microwave. Then, close the microwave door and press the start button.
Restock the canned food cabinet by taking the new fresh canned food from the counter and placing it in the cabinet. Then, take the old canned food from the cabinet and place it on the counter.
Close the electric kettle lid and turn on the electric kettle.
Open the cabinet and setup a tea strainer by placing it in the bowl upright.
Gather the eggs and milk located in the vicinity of the sink area and place them right next to the bowl.
Take the fruits from the plate on the dining counter and place two fruits in each bowl.
Open the cabinet, retrieve the rolling pin, and place it next to the meat on the cutting board to prepare for tenderizing.
Pick the cheese from the fridge and the cheese grater from the cabinet and place them next to the salad bowl.
Open the cabinet and move the ladle to the pot. Then close the cabinet.
Turn on the sink faucet with hot water and rinse the cutting board for ten seconds, then turn off the faucet. Push the cutting board to reach the water if necessary.
Pick up the bowls from the cabinet and place each bowl in front of a stool on the dining counter.
Take a sugar cube from the saucer and place it inside the coffee. Then, grab milk from the fridge and place it next to the coffee on the counter to sweeten the coffee.
Pick the croissant and place it on the pan. Then turn on the stove to warm the croissant.
Take the fork and place it on the left side of the plate. Then take the spoon and place it on the right side of the plate. Make sure they're directly next to the plate.
Place all breads on the cutting board.
Retrieve chicken drumstick, shrimp, and steak from the fridge and place them on the serving tray on the dining counter.
Place one cooked food and one vegetable from the large plate to each tupperware container.
Take the smaller bowl and place it next to the appetizer plate on the dining counter , and place the larger bowl next to the plate with cooked food.
Pick the pan and sponge and place them into the sink. Then turn on the water.
Pick up the tongs from the counter and place them near the plate next to the oven.
Close all open cabinet doors.
